topic: Australia spans about 3,990 km from Steep Point (WA, westernmost) to Cape Byron (NSW, easternmost), while the Moon's mean diameter is 3,474.8 km; the Moon's diameter laid along that line ends about 500 km short of the east coast; the Moon's surface (37.9 million km²) is about five times Australia's land (7.69 million km²).
policy_note: Every spoken or shown fact → a claim with ≥ 2 independent publishers; core claims need a primary/scholarly source.

myths.myth: Australia is bigger than the Moon.
myths.reality: Only wider, point to point. The Moon's surface is about 37.9 million km², roughly five times Australia's 7.69 million km².

landscape.our_gap: Wider-than-the-Moon posts are a flat Moon disc pasted over a map; nobody draws the real end-to-end geodesic on the satellite map, lays the Moon's diameter along the same line, and pins where it runs out.

ga_dims.title: Dimensions of Australia / Continental extremities
ga_dims.notes: Mainland extremities: Steep Point 26°09′S 113°09′E (west), Cape Byron 28°38′S 153°38′E (east); the mainland spans about 4,000 km east–west; land 7,692,024 km².

nasa_moon.title: Moon Fact Sheet
nasa_moon.notes: Moon mean diameter 3,474.8 km; surface 3.793 × 10^7 km².

ngs_geodesic.title: Inverse / geodesic distance computation
ngs_geodesic.notes: Great-circle computation reproduced in-house (haversine on mean Earth radius): Steep Point–Cape Byron 3,988 km; the 3,474 km mark along that arc falls near 148°E in north-western New South Wales, about 510 km short of Cape Byron.

wiki_extreme.title: List of extreme points of Australia
wiki_extreme.notes: Westernmost mainland point Steep Point (WA); easternmost mainland point Cape Byron (NSW).

jagran.title: Is Australia wider than the Moon?
jagran.notes: Australia about 4,000 km east to west versus the Moon's 3,474 km diameter; the Moon has about five times Australia's surface.
